description: Live SLF avalanche bulletin: danger level (1-5), avalanche problems with aspect and elevation, validity and advice text, for one warning region, a coordinate, or all of Switzerland. Outside the winter season it reports that no bulletin is in force

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp for an archived bulletin; omit for the current one

lat.description: WGS84 latitude, with lon; alternative to region

region.description: EAWS region id (e.g. CH-7114) or name, see list_avalanche_regions

name: get_avalanche_bulletin
